Overall accuracy alone doesn’t determine P(true | positive). You need the base rate π and the sensitivity s and false-positive rate f: P(true | positive) = sπ/[sπ + f(1−π)]. So there isn’t just one missing quantity unless “90% accurate” means both sensitivity and specificity are 90%; then only π is missing.
